ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast; approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels distributed across the distal and trailing edges against a 60% low-intensity black central and proximal region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense white mottling and contiguous high-intensity clusters concentrated along the trailing edges and distal tips of both lobes; dark pigmentation dominates the center near the peduncle, with irregular white spotting throughout.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 55-degree V-shaped notch; depth is approximately 15% of the visible vertical height of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations across the entire trailing boundary; irregular peaks and valleys with amplitudes ranging from 3-10 pixels, most pronounced on the outer distal edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edges tapering to sharp distal tips, with a slight concave sweep on the leading edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous roughly circular high-contrast white clusters (approximate diameters 5-15 pixels) densely packed on the distal halves of both lobes, particularly clustered near the tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple vertical and diagonal white linear marks (rake-like disruptions) visible on the left lobe (image-left) crossing the dark-to-light pigmentation boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring and localized tissue loss visible along the serrated trailing edge; significant high-intensity white patches at the distal tips suggesting historical trauma or heavy barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical mottling pattern with more solid white contiguous areas on the right lobe (image-right) inner trailing edge compared to the left.
